users.bio: Chord diagrams and modular arithmetic: pictures you could draw with a compass and a lot of patience.
Arithmetic geometry, drawn over the reals so you can see it before you compute it.
Optimization, gradient flows, and the interesting ways they fail.
Complex dynamics. Mostly Julia sets, occasionally the Mandelbrot set they live in.
Fourier analysis with spinning circles, for signal processing courses and the merely curious.
Open calculus materials, written and shared by instructors at a dozen universities.
